text: The smart equipment sleeps in its charging dock tonight.
What's left is iron, chalk, and something older watching from the squat rack.

greet.speaker: JUST THE GYM
text: No strap? No tin? Bold. What are we measuring tonight?

choices.text: Nothing. I just want to move things and put them back.
Honestly? Everything else made me feel behind. You look simple.

branch-nothing.speaker: JUST THE GYM
text: Pick a weight that respects you. Go again until it doesn't.

branch-confess.speaker: JUST THE GYM
text: Simple isn't the same as easy.
I pay in soreness, and my invoices always clear.
An hour passes without producing a single data point.
Just breath, iron, and the quiet arithmetic of one more rep.

tension.speaker: JUST THE GYM
text: Tomorrow morning, your legs will send you the bill.
Everything you've been dating would translate that into points for you.

choices.text: Some things should cost what they cost.
And yet I'll still glance at my recovery score on the way out.

closing.speaker: JUST THE GYM

text: Simple's still here when the dashboards bore you.
Bring water. Bring patience. That's the whole app.
I'll be the one not syncing.
